entities.summary: Franz von Assisi Karl Friedrich Klemens Jaroslav Alois Leopold Gerhard Telesphorus Odilius Johann Bosco Paul Marie, Prince von Lobkowicz was a Czech Catholic prelate and a member by birth of the Lobkowicz family. Lobkowicz served as titular bishop of Catabum Castra and as auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Prague, Czech Republic from 1990 to 1996. He was then appointed the first bishop of the Diocese of Ostrava-Opava, Czech Republic, serving from 1996 until his death.
